notes: Connected OSM course candidate. The selected loop is the longest simple source-node cycle after explicit exclusions; its association with a named circuit configuration requires review.
Source way order and shared node IDs are retained. No nearby endpoints are joined and no reference boundaries are read.
Some source ways lack one-way direction tags. Travel direction is provisional.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 75 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Straight segments between sparse pavement-edge positions measured on the pinned licensed satellite mosaic. Pale shoulders and the separate pit lane are excluded where distinguishable; route limits across pit openings and intervals between measurements are interpolated estimates. Source-image blur and trace displacement limit accuracy, and pixel spacing is not a positional-accuracy claim. These are unverified road-border estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Curbs are illustrative and banking is unknown. The main straight uses the visible straight pavement-edge lines between the measured endpoints at stations 390 and 600; 26 intermediate edge positions are intersections of those image-measured lines with the source cross-sections, rather than independent point observations. No source trace coordinates are changed.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
